name: Unsanctioned AI apps
description: AI identities a vendor has flagged as unapproved: shadow AI reported by Reco (isShadow) or an AI app Microsoft 365 Copilot reports as blocked (isBlocked). An AI app nobody has reviewed is not returned.

queries.name: query0
queries.query:
FIND NHI WITH isAi = true AND (isShadow = true OR isBlocked = true) AS ai
RETURN
  ai.displayName, ai._type, ai.aiPlatformName,
  ai.isShadow, ai.isBlocked, ai.webLink

name: AI identities with broad access
description: AI identities Wiz reports as holding admin or high privileges (hasAdminPrivileges or hasHighPrivileges). These can reach far more than an AI tool should.

queries.name: query0
queries.query:
FIND NHI WITH isAi = true AND (hasAdminPrivileges = true OR hasHighPrivileges = true) AS ai
RETURN
  ai.displayName, ai._type, ai.aiPlatformName,
  ai.hasAdminPrivileges, ai.hasHighPrivileges, ai.webLink

name: Inactive AI tokens
description: AI identities whose last recorded use (lastUsedOn) is more than 90 days ago. An identity with no recorded last use is not returned: unknown is not inactive.

queries.name: query0
queries.query:
FIND NHI WITH isAi = true AND lastUsedOn < date.now - 90 days AS ai
RETURN
  ai.displayName, ai._type, ai.aiPlatformName,
  ai.lastUsedOn, ai.webLink
